description: Post-earnings summary written by /earnings + /sweep slash commands. One file per ticker+period at data/summaries/<TICKER>_<PERIOD>.json. Ticker uses '_' for Bloomberg space (e.g. HBM_US); period uses '_' for space (e.g. FY2026_Q2). v2 adds an optional `drivers` array — absent means v1 (KPIs only); present means v2 (per-KPI cause explanations from the primary document). v3 adds optional `callSnippets` — verbatim pull-quotes from the earnings call. v1 + v2 files still validate.

ticker.description: Bloomberg-style canonical ticker (e.g. 'HBM US'). Must match the entity registry canonical for the companyId. Allows '/' for dual-class tickers (e.g. 'BF/B US'). Venue code is 2 alphanumeric chars — 'C1' (Shenzhen/Shanghai A-shares) is the one digit-bearing code in the registry, alongside pure-letter codes like 'US'.

period.description: Fiscal period label matching event.period (e.g. 'FY2026 Q2').

reported_at.description: Report date in YYYY-MM-DD. Must equal the event's eventDate for that period.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this summary was written.

headline.description: Verdict-style, plain-English, no numbers. Copy the FactPopover pattern.

kpis.description: Ledger-discipline KPI rows. Each MUST cite delta_basis; 'none' allowed only when the metric has no comparable predecessor.

summary_short.description: 1-2 sentences, MUST contain at least one numeric figure.

summary_long.description: <=120 words. Drivers + guidance change + balance sheet. No filler. No forward-looking speculation.

source_url.description: Direct link to the company release or EDGAR filing. NEVER an aggregator.

confidence_notes.description: Restatements, C1-vs-AISC quirks, by-product netting, streaming distortions, one-offs. Empty string if none. For kpi-only summaries this field MUST contain the disclaimer 'KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.' (or, when auto-downgraded from filing: 'primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data').

depth.description: Summary depth. 'filing' = full treatment with the release / 10-Q / press-release read; drivers and guidance assessed. 'kpi-only' = fast path composed purely from resolve-earnings-target.mjs output (SEC-verbatim shard KPIs + q/q + y/y deltas) with NO web search, NO document fetch, NO drivers, NO guidance. v2 files without this field default to 'filing' for backward compat.

drivers.description: Optional (v2). Per-KPI cause explanations. Each entry maps a metric (matching a kpi label, or the special value 'overall') to a direction + short explanation grounded in the primary document. HARD RULE — no macro narratives, no analyst-style theorizing, no causes the release doesn't state. If the release gives no reason for a move, write 'not explained in the release' and mark basis 'company-disclosed' (that's an honest read of what the document contains, not a fabrication).

metric.description: Matches a kpi.label from the same summary, or the literal 'overall' for release-level narrative.

explanation.description: <=50 words. Quotes no verbatim string longer than 15 words. 'not explained in the release' is a legitimate value.

basis.description: company-disclosed: filing/MD&A explicitly states this cause (the overwhelming majority). derived-arithmetic: pure decomposition from our own data (e.g. 'margin expansion is fully explained by revenue +8% against flat operating costs').

callSnippets.description: Optional (v3). Verbatim pull-quotes from the earnings-call transcript (or release when no transcript exists). Rules: (a) `quote` is verbatim — no paraphrase, no ellipsis-hiding cuts (…), ≤ 45 words. (b) `speaker` is the person who uttered it (CEO / CFO / analyst name); empty string when the source is a written release. (c) `topic` is a short two-word-max theme label (e.g. 'margins', 'guidance', 'china', 'buyback'). (d) `source.url` links to the transcript or release. (e) `source.locator` is optional deep-link (e.g. '#seg-4' or '#para-12') matching the Document ingest anchors. Absent field means no snippets extracted — do not render a section.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the call or release. No paraphrase. No hidden cuts.

speaker.description: Named speaker (e.g. 'Tim Cook, CEO'). Empty string when source is a written release.

role.description: Optional — 'prepared' = management prepared remarks / script, 'qa' = Q&A section. Absent when unknown.

topic.description: Short theme tag for chip grouping (e.g. 'margins', 'guidance', 'china', 'ai capex').
